item.description: AI-Assisted Knowledge Management Seed Drop this file into any vault to bootstrap a healthy, self-improving knowledge base.

item.title: Advanced Pattern Matching
item.description: Advanced Pattern Matching Using graph analysis to detect structural patterns and health issues in knowledge bases.

item.title: Anti-Pattern - Link Inflation
item.description: Anti-Pattern: Link Inflation Linking everything to everything dilutes meaning and creates navigational noise.

item.title: Anti-Pattern - Missing Negative Knowledge
item.description: Anti-Pattern: Missing Negative Knowledge Only capturing successes, not failures, creates an incomplete picture.

item.title: Anti-Pattern - Neglecting Maintenance
item.description: Anti-Pattern: Neglecting Maintenance Only adding new notes without reviewing or updating existing ones.

item.title: Anti-Pattern - Over-Organization
item.description: Anti-Pattern: Over-Organization Spending more time organizing than learning wastes energy on the wrong priorities.

item.title: Anti-Pattern - Perfectionism
item.description: Anti-Pattern: Perfectionism Never publishing a note because it’s “not ready” stops all progress.

item.title: Anti-Pattern - Single-Source Dependency
item.description: Anti-Pattern: Single-Source Dependency Depending entirely on one source makes notes fragile and unverifiable.

item.title: Frontier Exploration - Jargon vs Plain Language
item.description: Frontier Exploration - Jargon vs Plain Language in Knowledge Bases This note elaborates on Seed rules about terminology and multi-audience vaults.

item.title: Frontier Exploration - Threshold Knowledge
item.description: Frontier Exploration: Threshold Knowledge Threshold knowledge captures the moments or conditions when something transitions from one state to another.
